definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese establishment serving tea and light refreshments, often found at scenic spots, temples, or along historic roads.
In the geisha districts, a tea house that arranges geisha entertainment and serves as a venue for banquets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{茶屋|ちゃや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We took a break at a tea house near the temple.

examples.japanese: お{茶屋|ちゃや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: We had matcha and Japanese sweets at the tea house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{風情|ふぜい}→風情：09057_fuzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧お{茶屋|ちゃや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's an atmospheric tea house in the garden.

examples.japanese: {祇園|ぎおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{茶屋|ちゃや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We hold a banquet at a tea house in Gion.

examples.japanese: お{茶屋|ちゃや}⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花街|かがい}→花街：17224_kagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{茶屋|ちゃや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many long-established geisha tea houses in Kyoto's entertainment districts.

notes:
お{茶屋|ちゃや} has two distinct meanings depending on context.

TRADITIONAL TEA HOUSE (sense 1):
- Found at tourist spots, temples, shrines, and parks
- Serves ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧ (matcha), ⟦{煎茶|せんちゃ}→煎茶：13407_sencha⟧ (sencha), and ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧ (Japanese sweets)
- Often has ⟦{畳|たたみ}→畳：02224_tatami⟧ seating with views of gardens or scenery

GEISHA TEA HOUSE (sense 2):
- Found in ⟦{花街|かがい}→花街：17224_kagai⟧/{花柳界|かりゅうかい} (geisha districts) like {祇園|ぎおん}
- Requires an introduction (⟦{一見|いちげん}さん→一見さん：16186_ichigensan⟧お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ = no first-time visitors without introduction)
- Arranges {芸妓|げいこ}/⟦{舞妓|まいこ}→舞妓：15099_maiko⟧ entertainment
- お{茶屋|ちゃや}⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧: enjoying entertainment at a geisha house
